component.name: scs-rclient
component.summary: GUI wrapper for rclone to replace Dreamweaver WebDAV functionality

description.p: scs-rclient is a modern desktop GUI wrapper for rclone, bundling rclone directly to streamline WebDAV synchronization and file transfers.

ul.li: Embedded and verified rclone binary sidecar
Intuitive WebDAV configuration and authentication management
Console output viewer with real-time logs and transfer status
Cross-platform desktop integration built on Tauri and Rust

description.p: Release with bundled rclone sidecar, WebDAV configuration, and Flatpak support.
